domain: DEATH-ADJACENT POST-STAMP QUOTE-WINDOW BOOK on the reorg-path cohort - the evidenced Form-15 census used as an EVENT SET; a POST-STAMP CONTINUATION book with survival semantics declared ex-ante, which is NEVER a death-reaction book (P3 survival-quote honesty)
title: Post-stamp continuation: long the 20-bar window after the evidenced Form-15 arrival on NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL names, sector-residual, forced-flow exhaustion mechanism - reorg/survival semantics declared ex-ante

mechanism_lineage.why_the_stamp_arrival_could_carry_inform: For the 219 priced entities whose quote series continues past the evidenced Form-15 stamp (lag quantiles by verdict: p10 +227 to p95 +2,363 days, p50 +744), the stamp is not terminal - it is the legal delisting instant of a REORG-PATH name whose equity keeps trading. The stamp arrival is a compelled, low-salience disclosure that triggers FORCED FLOW: mandate holders barred from holding delisted/OTC names sell into a thinning tape regardless of the recovery path, while the natural buyers (reorg residual claimants) are slow to accumulate - OTC friction and limited attention delay their entry. The claim: the 20-bar window after the evidenced stamp carries positive drift net of sector beta (forced-selling exhaustion), a name-specific flow effect that neither SPY nor a static sector factor spans. The Form-15 census has been universe-only in V9; the stamp arrival has never been used as an event instant.
mechanism_lineage.honesty_boundary_read_first: THIS IS NOT A DEATH-REACTION BOOK. P3 survival-quote honesty is honored at the design's root: the booked windows are post-stamp quotes of NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL names and carry REORG/SURVIVAL semantics, declared here ex-ante. The family is presented as a post-stamp continuation book on reorg-path names and can never be presented as, or counted as, a death-reaction book. The genuine dying-name post-death universe (DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED: 64 entities at >= 20 bars, 9 at >= 60) is EXCLUDED-WITH-REASON, not silently dropped.
mechanism_lineage.why_the_distinct_mechanism_is_not_H1: SFV12-A5-H1 conditions on the DYING name's terminal quote-gap shape and trades that name's SECTOR PEERS at the death arrival (contagion, funded clock V12-D1-DEATH-EVENT-FINALQ). THIS family books the STAMP NAME's OWN continuing quote series after the arrival (forced-flow continuation, funded clock V12-D2-DEATH-EVENT-POST). Disjoint clocks, disjoint cohorts (1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED triggers vs 219 NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL books), disjoint instruments (peers vs self), disjoint mechanisms (cross-sectional contagion vs single-name flow). Neither is a parameter wiggle of the other.

falsifiable_prediction: The 20-bar post-stamp window on reorg-path names outperforms its sector-ETF hedge net of band costs in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.10; (c) folds positive >= 2 of 3; (d) populated-fold PF >= 0.8; (e) max fold MDD <= 0.15; (f) ETF positive share <= 0.50; (g) fold positive share <= 0.5; (h) anchor overall SPY-excess alpha > 0; (i) the sham-event control's same-sign alpha < 0.5x the anchor's - reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (j) the pre-stamp bar-completeness neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (k) D2 pre-selection gates pass: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL THIRTEEN veto entries and anchor-vs-control identifiability (self-subsumption rho > 0.98 kills pre-score); (l) the book remains non-vacuous after the declared 10,000 USD post-window liquidity floor. Availability-lag mutation (P3, EXTENDED to Form-15): pushing a Form-15 arrival later shifts the event and its 20-bar window exactly one period and changes nothing else; a larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed. REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes - this family is EXPECTED to face the A9-F cost cheap-kill and states so ex-ante.

clock.conditioner_definition: The identifying conditioner (neighbour arm) is PRE-STAMP BAR COMPLETENESS, a print-attendance COUNT, not a return: printed_bars(e) = number of EOD bars of e in the 20 sessions ending at the last session with date <= evidenced stamp (all inputs within max_age_days 800). Class: ORDERLY-REORG iff printed_bars >= 15; GAPPED-REORG iff printed_bars <= 14. The cut 15 is a single round number frozen at the wave SHA. This is a materially different cross-sectional cut from the anchor's unconditional window (it separates reorg paths where a functioning tape existed into the stamp from halted-print paths), not a parameter wiggle.
clock.event_semantics: STRICT_NEXT_BAR default: booked windows contain bars with date > evidenced stamp; SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE is NOT used anywhere in this family (declared ex-ante). Holding window k = 20 bookable bars (the census >= 20-bar rung). Event legs force-flat at fold boundaries. The stamp arrival is P-1 evidenced (the filing evidence IS the stamp; asserted dates never used; census: 0 missing, 0 mismatch).

event_book_invariants_ack: P3 event-book invariants acknowledged and honored in full. (1) LAG MUTATION, EXTENDED: pushing a Form-15 arrival later shifts the event and its STRICT_NEXT_BAR 20-bar window exactly one period, changing nothing else - the sham control recomputes under the same mutation (P-3). (2) Window convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR everywhere; no SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE anywhere. (3) Dead-leg honesty: the death-inclusive price series is used exactly as recorded; a booked survival name whose prints stop mid-window exits at last close, no survivorship re-substitution; zero-window events counted and excluded-with-reason. (4) Survival-quote honesty, honored at the root: the booked quotes carry reorg/survival semantics declared ex-ante in mechanism_lineage, universe.class_handling and d2_predeclarations.d; the family is a POST-STAMP CONTINUATION book and can never be presented as a death-reaction book; the genuine dying-name post-death universe (64/9 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED entities) is excluded-with-reason. (5) P-1 availability evidence absolute: only evidenced stamps enter.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule - anchor, neighbour, control. All arms run under evidenced semantics (P-1/P-3); the control recomputes under any semantics change.
arms.anchor: Long post-stamp continuation book: at each eligible NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL event, LONG the name for 20 bookable bars starting STRICT_NEXT_BAR after the evidenced stamp, hedged SHORT the mapped SPDR sector ETF share (sector-residual leg, provision 2.1). Equal-weight across concurrent events; gross cap 2.0; CASH absorbs imbalance. Claim: forced delisting flow exhausts inside the window and the continuing series drifts UP net of sector beta.
arms.neighbour: Pre-stamp bar-completeness cut (required SUPPORT, same sign): only ORDERLY-REORG events (printed_bars >= 15 of the last 20 pre-stamp sessions). The claim this tests: the forced-flow channel requires a functioning tape into the stamp - a market through which mandated sellers can actually be forced - so the rebound concentrates in continuous-print reorgs and the gapped/halted reorg paths carry no exploitable post-stamp drift. If the anchor's spread exists only in gapped paths, the flow interpretation is withdrawn (declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.control: MANDATORY sham-event placebo (P3 lane2_control_mandate), verbatim census machinery: deterministic sector-matched host pairing - DEAD_EVIDENCED priced entities with evidenced death date matched to ALIVE_EVIDENCED priced hosts by cohort sector tag; within sector both sides sorted by CIK, dead[i] -> alive[i mod n_alive]; no fuzzy matching; sectors with zero alive hosts yield UNMATCHED (never guessed). Offset convention verbatim: offset_days = death_date(dead) - first_bar_date(dead); sham_date = first_bar_date(host) + offset_days. The sham book runs the IDENTICAL machinery with the HOST's own series: LONG the host for the same 20-bar STRICT window at its sham_date, hedged SHORT the host's mapped sector ETF share; the host inherits the paired event's eligibility class so class mix is preserved. Any alpha surviving under the sham is a calendar/sector-composition artifact, not stamp-event information. 671 UNMAPPED-SECTOR dead entities have NO host: they are excluded-with-reason IDENTICALLY from anchor, neighbour and control (events without a matched host are dropped in all arms, preserving anchor-vs-sham comparability) - never guessed; census counts on record: 1,098 mapped-sector pairs over 391 hosts, 671 UNMAPPED unmatched. RUNNABILITY PROOF (census): host-side clear windows at matched offsets w20 = 3,037,029 of 3,518,470 positions with 391/391 hosts holding >= 1 runnable window - the host side of the sham always fills; anchor-side runnable count for THIS family's event set is 209 (census post_death_strict_bars, survival verdict, >= 20 bars). Kill rule (frozen): sham reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x on the identifying metric (per-event 20-bar window alpha vs risk-matched SPY, pooled) -> family DEAD.
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs control: the sham relabels event timing onto living hosts' arbitrary calendar windows while preserving sector and class composition - declared expected pooled Spearman rho(anchor, sham) 0.00-0.10, per-date gate 0.30; measured at D2 before selection, never argued post hoc.

book_form.form: daily long sector-residual event book - book_form provision 2.1 INVOKED with frozen justification: the mechanism is NAME-SPECIFIC forced flow (who must sell the delisting name), so sector beta is stripped at the leg level with the mapped SPDR sector ETF; the justification is frozen here before selection. The frozen exposure gates, the ETF-share gate (<= 0.50, binding on the hedge legs, expected share roughly balanced) and the SPY-excess gates apply unchanged, and D2 novelty is measured on conditioning exposures.
book_form.costs: frozen band model verbatim, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to booked PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py - BAND_BPS = {A: 10.0, B: 15.0, C: 25.0}; band_of ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps * cost_mult / 10,000. Stress rerun cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL, reported alongside base. Fail-closed per L-I3 throughout.
book_form.expected_cost_blend_and_where_the_cheap_: DECLARED EX-ANTE: survival names are post-delisting OTC tapes - band-C (25 bps per side) dominance is EXPECTED; the stress rerun (50 bps) is the EXPECTED kill zone. The census measures post-death pooled bar dollar-volume p50 = 2,108 USD with p25 = 0, and even the filtered cell (>= 20 bars AND median >= 10k) holds at most 105 entities across both verdicts. This family survives only if the 20-bar window drift clears linear-in-fills costs at the frozen floor; A9-F adjudicates that ceiling and if it kills the clock, that is a correct REJECT - the family claims no immunity.

failure_interpretation.anchor_expectancy_le_0: forced-selling exhaustion after the stamp does not exist or is efficiently priced - withdraw the family; no rescue variant (REJECT is a successful outcome).
failure_interpretation.a9f_cost_ceiling_kill: if the per-decision cost ceiling at the frozen floor exceeds the measurable 20-bar drift envelope on the eligible base, the clock dies at A9-F BEFORE any scored cell - the correct cheap death, explicitly anticipated by this proposal.
failure_interpretation.control_ratio_ge_0.5_same_sign: the drift is a calendar/sector-composition artifact, not stamp-event information - family dies; the pre-declared falsification outcome and a successful test (falsification-by-control cluster precedent).
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: the rebound does not require a continuous pre-stamp tape - withdraw the forced-flow interpretation (support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
failure_interpretation.folds_positive_lt_2_or_fold_positive_sha: the effect does not survive regime change - die.
failure_interpretation.spy_excess_fail: the drift is market/sector context, not incremental information - die.
failure_interpretation.etf_share_gt_0.50: hedge leakage through book construction - die.
failure_interpretation.populated_fold_pf_lt_0.8_or_vacuous_book: the book degrades to noise or empties under the eligibility floors - die (non-vacuity: an empty book is a failure, never a pass).
failure_interpretation.pre_selection_gate_fail: identifiability or novelty failure dies at D2 before any scored cell (INELIGIBLE_*); the cheap death, correctly taken.
failure_interpretation.availability_lag_mutation_fail: implementation leak - the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed; no repair after PnL is visible.
failure_interpretation.thin_margin_rule: a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin per P-2 regardless of pass count and treated as candidate-not-edge.

d2_predeclarations.a_conditioning_exposures_for_novelty_mea: The exposure vectors D2 will rank (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled over shared dates/universe) against ALL THIRTEEN veto entries at pooled |rho| <= 0.20, measured BEFORE selection: (i) the per-entity net leg weight of the anchor book per decision date; (ii) the raw per-event conditioner: printed_bars count (and its ORDERLY-REORG/GAPPED-REORG class) over event names at their arrivals. Declared input-disjointness claims, each still rho-measured never argued: no price return, semivariance, vol-level, WC-stock, Goodwill, accrual-flow, depletion-interaction or cash-level quantity enters any exposure (the nine V9 entries); the event is an evidenced Form-15 death stamp, not a vintage/amendment filing, and no filing-event-time drift observable of the vetoed form is computed (filing-event reaction event-time space); no amendment-process timing/cadence/latency observable enters (V10 timing form, V10 revision direction/breadth form, V11 cadence-latency form); sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure (sector-exposure form).
d2_predeclarations.b_anchor_vs_control_identifiability: Pre-declared before selection: expected pooled Spearman rho(anchor, sham) in 0.00-0.10 with per-date |rho| <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates; measured from data alone (leg weights and class labels, no PnL). SELF-SUBSUMPTION KILL: if the sham control's per-period series correlates rho > 0.98 with the anchor's per-period series - i.e. the control is an implementation duplicate rather than an independent placebo - the family is killed pre-score (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE), fail-closed.
d2_predeclarations.c_unmapped_671_host_gap_answer: The 671 UNMAPPED-sector dead entities have NO matched living host and are EXCLUDED-WITH-REASON identically from anchor, neighbour and sham control - never guessed, consistent with the P2 not_funded entry. Effect on this family: anchor events without a matched host drop in ALL arms (the anchor base shrinks from 209 eligible toward its mapped-sector subset; the exact count is computed at A9-F from the deterministic rule and reported); anchor-vs-sham comparability is preserved because the exclusion is identical across arms. A sham that cannot run on the remaining base is a DESIGN FAILURE and kills the family pre-score - it is never counted as a pass.
d2_predeclarations.d_survival_quote_semantics_ex_ante: DECLARED: every booked window in this family is a post-stamp quote of a NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL name and carries REORG/SURVIVAL semantics - the entity did not economically die at the stamp. The family is presented as a POST-STAMP CONTINUATION book on reorg-path names and can NEVER be presented as, or counted as, a death-reaction book (P3 survival-quote honesty, verbatim honored). The genuine dying-name post-death universe - DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED 64 entities at >= 20 bars, 9 at >= 60 - is EXCLUDED-WITH-REASON (count level, liquidity ceiling, and semantics: booking it would be a different, death-reaction family that the thin universe cannot fund at three arms over three folds).

literature: Macey, J.R., Mitchell, L.E., Netter, J.M. (1988), 'Restrictions on Takeovers: An Analysis of the 1987 Delaware Legislation', and the forced-flow literature it anchors: mandated institutional constraints around delisting create price pressure unrelated to fundamentals.

Greenwood, R., Thesmar, D. (2011), 'Stock Price Fragility', Journal of Financial Economics 102(3), 471-490 (ownership concentration and mandated flows create fragility and predictable pressure dynamics).

Coval, J., Stafford, E. (2007), 'Asset Fire Sales (and Purchases) in Equity Markets', Journal of Financial Economics 86(2), 479-512 (forced selling creates temporary price pressure followed by reversal - the exhaustion channel this book tests).

Harris, L., Gurel, E. (1986), 'Price and Volume Effects Associated with Changes in the S&P 500 List: New Evidence for the Existence of Price Pressures', Journal of Finance 41(3), 815-829 (index/delist events produce pressure effects that partially revert).
Hirshleifer, D., Lim, S.S., Teoh, S.H. (2009), 'Driven to Distraction', Journal of Finance 64(5), 2289-2325 (limited attention delays the accumulation by natural buyers of low-salience events).
